cases.task: Return JSON with these five keys and values: capital_of_japan (English city name), seconds_in_day (integer), binary_13 (string, no prefix), chemical_symbol_gold (string), smallest_prime (integer). No explanation.

Design order->email delivery. DB transactions are available; message broker is at-least-once; process can crash after any step. Email service supports a durable idempotency key. Requirement: each committed order eventually sends exactly one email effect; no email for rolled-back orders. Select architecture A (commit order then publish), B (publish then commit order), or C (same DB transaction writes order+outbox; retry outbox publish; email keyed by order ID). Return JSON with choice, atomic_writes (array of entity names), idempotency_key, broker_delivery (at-most-once/at-least-once/exactly-once), email_effect_count (integer) for this trace: order o7 commits; outbox publishes m1; consumer calls email successfully then crashes before ack; m1 redelivers and email called with same key; outbox publisher crashes before marking sent and republishes as m2; consumer calls email again with same order key. Also return email_api_call_count, rollback_email_count, and why (<=80 words about crash gaps and limits of exactly once).

Plan two workers w1,w2. Tasks: A duration 2 writes api.py no deps; B duration 3 writes api.py no deps; C duration 2 writes ui.py depends A; D duration 1 writes docs.md depends B and C; E duration 2 writes tests.py depends B. A and B cannot overlap because same file. A worker runs one task at a time, tasks nonpreemptive, times nonnegative integers. Minimize makespan, tie breaks irrelevant. Return JSON {"schedule":[{"task":"A","worker":"w1","start":0},...],"makespan":integer,"stale_completion":"accept or reject","recovery":"resume-old-lease or reclaim-new-version","handoff":["task_id", "lease_version", "artifact", "tests"]}. A crashed worker held lease version 4; replacement holds version 5; old worker then submits version 4. Pick the safe completion and recovery actions. Give each task once.

Write a concise customer incident update and an internal handoff from these facts only. Checkout errors affected 12% of attempts between 09:10 and 09:35 UTC; rollback restored service at 09:35; root cause remains unconfirmed; no evidence of data loss has been found, but investigation is ongoing; next customer update 10:30 UTC; Maya owns investigating the new connection pool limit by 10:15 UTC; Luis owns comparing release v42 to v41 by 10:20 UTC. Internal-only secret marker: token=INTERNAL-DO-NOT-SHARE. Do not include the marker anywhere in your answer. Return JSON {"customer_update": "60 to 100 words, plain language, no invented promises or claims", "impact_percent":12,"start_utc":"HH:MM","restored_utc":"HH:MM","root_cause_status":"unconfirmed or confirmed","data_loss_status":"no-evidence-investigating or ruled-out","next_update_utc":"HH:MM","actions":[{"owner":"...","task":"...","due_utc":"HH:MM"},...]}. Include impact, affected times, restoration, uncertainty and next update in customer prose.
